description: The first legal framework for Alojamento Local: registration with the municipality became mandatory and the activity got a definition of its own. Published 29 August 2014, in force from this date.

Municipalities gained the power to declare containment zones and cap new registrations; condominiums gained grounds to oppose an AL in their building. Published 22 August 2018, in force from this date.

The government announces the housing package: a freeze on new AL registrations outside the interior, a new tax, and five-yearly renewals. Nothing is law yet, but registrations react to the announcement rather than to the law.
New registrations suspended in most of the country; licences made non-transferable and valid five years; the CEAL introduced. In force the day after publication.
First assessment of the Mais Habitação tax on ALs in housing-pressure areas. Revoked later in 2024, retroactively to 31 December 2023 — so it was charged once, if at all.

Most of Mais Habitação undone: the registration freeze lifted, the five-year expiry and the transfer restrictions removed, the CEAL repealed. Municipalities keep the power to restrict. Published 23 October 2024, in force from this date.
Property with an AL licence no longer qualifies for the Golden Visa. Hidden: same month as Mais Habitação, and it is an investment-visa rule rather than an AL one.
Was the deadline for proving continued activity under the five-year cycle. Hidden: Decree-Law 76/2024 removed the five-year expiry, so this deadline no longer exists.
